_comment: turn-pipeline.md status:"done" contract, empty-content case — report_status's own schema says done means "the task is complete and your message is the answer", which is false if there is no message. activities/activities/model_call.py must coerce that contradictory status to "working" (not trust it at face value) so the no-progress guard gives the model one real retry instead of turn.go's `done` branch breaking on it and delivering nothing. Regression for a real bug found via a live reminder request whose second step returned empty content with status=done, ending the turn with nothing visible to the user.
